fields.name: material
fields.tooltip: The material the renderer's SpeedLinesFeature holds (Hidden/FiniteRunner/SpeedLines). Written by Tools → FiniteRunner → Install Speed Lines Feature; a driver spawned at play time reads it from here.

fields.name: intensity
fields.tooltip: Master dial. 0 = off (the render pass is skipped entirely), 1 = the full effect. Gameplay scales it further with SpeedLines.SetIntensity.

fields.name: speedBand
fields.tooltip: Speed band as a fraction of the reference speed the owner hands the driver (the runner: Light Speed). Lines start at X and reach full strength at Y.

fields.name: responseSharpness
fields.tooltip: How fast the intensity follows the speed (exponential response, 1/s). Low = a slow build that survives a brake pad; high = snaps.

fields.name: focusResponse
fields.tooltip: How fast the convergence point follows the target's screen position (1/s).

fields.name: color
fields.tooltip: Line colour; alpha scales the whole overlay.

fields.name: lineCount
fields.tooltip: Angular cells of the coarse (wide) layer. Fixed on purpose — density × intensity decides how many hold a line, so cells never drift between flicker frames.

fields.name: fineLineCount
fields.tooltip: Angular cells of the fine (thin) layer drawn under the coarse one.

fields.name: density
fields.tooltip: Share of cells that hold a line at full intensity.

fields.name: lineWidth
fields.tooltip: Width of a line at the screen edge, as a fraction of its cell (the fine layer draws at half).

fields.name: taperLength
fields.tooltip: Distance over which a wedge widens from its tip to full width, in screen heights.

fields.name: innerRadius
fields.tooltip: Radius of the clear middle, in screen heights: Y at the start of the band, shrinking to X at full speed — the lines close in on the ship as it nears the reference speed.

fields.name: innerJitter
fields.tooltip: Per-line random spread of the inner tip around the clear radius (0 = every tip on the same circle).

fields.name: flickerRate
fields.tooltip: Pattern re-rolls per second — the lines jump between hand-drawn frames rather than sliding.

fields.name: edgeSoftness
fields.tooltip: Anti-aliasing width of a line's edge, in pixels. 0 = razor.

fields.name: farMultiplier
fields.tooltip: Intensity multiplier in the Far chase framing (mode 0).

fields.name: closeMultiplier
fields.tooltip: Intensity multiplier in the Close chase framing (mode 1).

fields.name: firstPersonMultiplier
fields.tooltip: Intensity multiplier in first person (mode 2) — the cockpit view is where the effect sells hardest.

fields.name: cinematicMultiplier
fields.tooltip: Intensity multiplier during the cinematic shot (mode 3: the loop, the slow-mo jump). 0 = off — the lines are a first-person-ish speed cue over the chase view and only clutter a showcase shot taken from the side.
